newsitem.title: JAPAN: Murdoch says in talks to buy L.A. Dodgers.
newsitem.headline: Murdoch says in talks to buy L.A. Dodgers.

text.p: Media tycoon Rupert Murdoch confirmed on Wednesday that he is negotiating to buy one of America's most famous sports franchises, the Los Angeles Dodgers baseball team.

"We are interested in the Dodgers," Murdoch, in Tokyo to launch his company News Corp's Japanese digital satellite broadcasting venture, told a news conference. "Other media companies now in America have great sporting teams."
Murdoch said he was in discussions with L.A. Dodgers president Peter O'Malley over the deal, but declined to comment on the price or any other details of the potential purchase.
"That's approximately what Mr O'Malley and I have been talking about. I can't say more than that," he said.

The sale, if completed, would reportedly be worth $350 million, and could top $400 million if Dodger stadium in Los Angeles and the club's spring training facilities at Dodger Town are included in the deal.
On Tuesday, the Dodgers sought permission from the Major League Baseball Executive Council to enter serious discussions with the Fox Group, a unit of Murdoch's News Corp, about a possible sale.
